title: PostgreSQL Performance and Concurrency
description: Diagnose slow queries and design safe concurrent transactions in production PostgreSQL.
learningOutcomes: Read query plans and design useful indexes

lessons.title: EXPLAIN, ANALYZE, and Query Plans
lessons.description: Read planner output and find the real source of query cost.

lessons.title: Index Design and Query Shapes
lessons.description: Match B-tree, partial, composite, expression, and GIN indexes to workload shape.
learningObjectives: Choose index types and column order

lessons.title: Isolation, Locks, and Deadlocks
lessons.description: Reason about visibility, contention, anomalies, and retryable failures.

lessons.title: JSONB, Partitioning, and Data-model Tradeoffs
lessons.description: Use advanced storage features only where their operational costs pay off.

lessons.title: Pooling, Vacuum, and Production Diagnostics
lessons.description: Keep connections, statistics, table health, and maintenance visible.
